title: Swiggy Board Caps Aggregate Foreign Ownership at 49.5% for IOCC Status
summary: Qualifies quick-commerce Instamart as an Indian-Owned and Controlled Company (IOCC).

blocks.text: 🪝 Swiggy Board Caps Aggregate Foreign Ownership at 49.5% for IOCC Status. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Qualifies quick-commerce Instamart as an Indian-Owned and Controlled Company (IOCC).
Foreign Cap: Foreign ownership capped at 49.5% on a fully diluted basis.
IOCC Advantage: Permits direct inventory ownership and sale on quick-commerce platform.
Swiggy foreign ownership cap (49.5%) vs standard retail FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) caps.
